kv7.4:1.3: Labbhā cetasiko dhammo paresaṃ dātun ti?
kv7.4:1.5: Labbhā cetasiko dhammo paresaṃ dātun ti?
kv7.4:2.4: Dānaṃ aniṭṭhaphalaṃ akantaphalaṃ amanuññaphalaṃ secanakaphalaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ dukkhavipākan ti?
kv7.4:2.6: Nanu dānaṃ iṭṭhaphalaṃ kantaphalaṃ manuññaphalaṃ asecanakaphalaṃ sukhindriyaṃ sukhavipākan ti?
kv7.4:2.8: Hañci dānaṃ iṭṭhaphalaṃ kantaphalaṃ manuññaphalaṃ asecanakaphalaṃ sukhindriyaṃ sukhavipākaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe
kv7.4:3.1: Dānaṃ iṭṭhaphalaṃ vuttaṃ Bhāgavatā, cīvaraṃ dānan ti?
kv7.4:3.3: Cīvaraṃ iṭṭhaphalaṃ kantaphalaṃ manuññaphalaṃ asecanakaphalaṃ sukhindriyaṃ sukhavipākan ti?
kv7.4:3.5: Dānaṃ iṭṭhaphalaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā, piṇḍapāto, senāsanaṃ, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāro dānan ti?
kv7.4:3.7: Gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāro iṭṭhaphalo kantaphalo manuññaphalo asecanakaphalo sukhindriyo sukhavipāko ti?
kv7.4:6.3: Tena hi cetasiko dhammo dānan ti. 5.
kv7.4:7.5: "Pañc' imāni Bhikkhave dānāni mahādānāni aggaññāni rattaññāni vaṃsaññāni porāṇāni asaṃkiṇṇāni asaṃkiṇṇapubbāni na saṃkīyanti, na saṃkīyissanti, appaṭikuṭṭhāni samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
kv7.4:7.7: Idha Bhikkhave ariyasāvako pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti,
kv7.4:7.8: pāṇātipātā paṭivirato Bhikkhave ariyasāvako aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ abhayaṃ deti, averaṃ deti, abyāpajjhaṃ deti,
kv7.4:7.9: aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ abhayaṃ datvā, averaṃ datvā, abyāpajjhaṃ datvā aparimāṇassa abhayassa averassa abyāpajjhassa bhāgī hoti:
kv7.4:7.10: idaṃ Bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ dānaṃ mahādānaṃ aggaññaṃ rattaññaṃ vaṃsaññaṃ porānaṃ asaṃkiṇṇaṃ asaṃkiṇṇapubbaṃ na saṃkīyati, na saṃkīyissati, appaṭikuṭṭhaṃ samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
kv7.4:7.11: Puna ca paraṃ Bhikkhave ariyasāvako adinnādāyaṃ pahāya --pe--
kv7.4:7.15: surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato Bhikkhave ariyasāvako aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ abhayaṃ deti, averaṃ deti, abyāpajjhaṃ deti,
kv7.4:7.16: aparimāṇānaṃ s-ttānaṃ abhayaṃ datvā, averaṃ datvā, abyāpajjhaṃ datvā aparimāṇassa abhayassa averassa abyāpajjhassa bhāgī hoti:
kv7.4:7.17: idaṃ Bhikkhave pañcamaṃ dānaṃ māhādānaṃ aggaññaṃ rattaññaṃ vaṃsaññaṃ porānaṃ asaṃkiṇṇaṃ asaṃkiṇṇapubbaṃ na saṃkīyati, na saṃkīyissati, appaṭikuṭṭhaṃ samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
kv7.4:7.18: Imāni kho Bhikkhave pañca dānāni mahādānāni aggaññāni rattaññāni vaṃsaññāni porāṇāni asaṃkiṇṇāni asaṃkiṇṇapubbāni na saṃkīyanti, na saṃkīyissanti, appaṭikuṭṭhāni samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññuhīti. "
kv7.4:7.21: Tena hi cetasiko dhammo dānan ti. 6.
kv7.4:8.5: "Idh' ekacco annaṃ deti, pānaṃ deti, vatthaṃ deti, yānaṃ deti, mālaṃ deti, gandhaṃ deti, vilepanaṃ deti, seyyaṃ deti, āvasathaṃ deti, padīpeyyaṃ detīti."
kv7.4:9.3: Deyyadhammo iṭṭhaphalo kantaphalo manuññaphalo asecanakaphalo sukhindriyo sukhavipāko ti?
kv7.4:9.5: Dānaṃ iṭṭhaphalaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā, cīvaraṃ dānan ti?
kv7.4:9.7: Cīvaraṃ iṭṭhaphalaṃ kantaphalaṃ manuññaphalaṃ asecanakaphalaṃ sukhindriyaṃ sukhavipākan ti?
kv7.4:9.9: Dānaṃ iṭṭhaphalaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā, piṇḍapāto dānaṃ,
kv7.4:9.13: Gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāro iṭṭhaphalo kantaphalo manuññaphalo asecanakaphalo sukhindriyo sukhavipāko ti?
